Commentary.Commentary: Now, the Indians have a target of 287 in front of them. Not going to be easy by any means on this deadly surface. Time is not an issue, but they will need their openers to provide them a good, solid start. Imperative that they do. After looking at what the tourists were doing with the ball, the Australian speedsters would be raring to go themselves. Should be exciting. Don't go anywhere, it's about to begin shortly.

Earlier, it was Khawaja (who scored a fifty) and Paine who got most of the work done. Saw the morning session out with ease and threaded a neat fifty-stand between them, which set the foundations up. The collapse obviously didn't help, and Shami and Bumrah were responsible for that. The former ended with a 6-fer, while the latter bagged 3 of his own.

So India finally manage to wrap up the Australian tail but this final pair might have just enough damage to the Indians. Whatever the visitors ate for lunch, it certainly worked as the Indian pacers were breathing fire the moment the second session began. From 192/4, the hosts were reduced to 207/9. India would have felt confident, but Starc and Hazlewood managed to add 36 important runs between them in just 38 balls. Could prove to be all the difference in the end.

OUT! Bowled 'em! That's it. AUSTRALIA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 243. Bumrah comes back and gets a wicket off the second ball. Starc backs away too far and Bumrah bowls it nice and full on off stump. The left-hander goes for a defensive push on the off side but misses the ball completely. The ball knocks the off stump. Bumrah has his third. Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood run off the field to quickly get their pads off before they come back to bowl. INDIA NEED 287 TO WIN. Not going to be easy, but it could have been much worse had it not been for this incredible hour and a half of bowling from them after Lunch.
Outside off, Hazlewood pushes it to deep point and gets off strike.
Jasprit Bumrah back on.

FOUR! The ball is outside off and Starc pushes at it lazily. The ball takes the edge and goes wide of second slip. Kohli dives to his left but can only get a hand on it. The ball runs away for a boundary. The lead is 285 now.
Wide outside off, Josh pushes it through to deep point for a single.
Well defended towards mid off.
WIDE! Too high and the ball is well above Hazlewood's head who sways out of the way of this bouncer on middle. The Perth crowd loves the umpire's decision.
Defended off the back foot towards cover.
Short ball outside off, Starc prods ahead slightly and just drops it on the off side. The batsmen get a single.
Shot! Well played by the number eleven once more. Stands tall and powers this over point. Doesn't reach the fence but the batsmen come back for three. Such precious runs these.
Umesh Yadav is brought back into the attack.
Coming in at first and then straightening up, beats the outside edge of the hanging bat.
Pushes this just wide of the cover fielder and crosses over.
Oooh! Nice. Hazlewood thinks this is going to be fuller, so leans ahead, but Ishant bangs it in short. Josh still somehow manages to evade it.
FOUR! Excellent. He's played that shot well so far. Uses Sharma's pace and just steers it behind point for a boundary.
Leans into the full ball and knocks it to mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Hazlewood slaps, only to miss.

FOUR! Another boundary, this has been an excellent over for Australia. Too straight in line as Shami bowls it full, Starc flicks it through square leg to send it across the boundary line. All these are bonus runs for the Aussies.
Short of a good length outside off, the same story again. A play and a miss.
Just short. Sharp bounce as it's moving away from around off, Hazlewood gets an edge which falls short of Rahane at gully. A single is taken.
On the fifth stump line, some shape away, the left-hander Hazlewood plays and misses again.

FOUR! Better. Much better. This is a good shot from Hazlewood. Him and Starc are putting on vital runs for Australia. Back of a length outside off, Hazlewood with an angled blade steers it past gully for a boundary.
Good length ball going away from the batsman, Josh plays away from his body without any foot movement and misses.
FOUR BYES! Sharma angles this down the leg side, Starc looks to flick but misses and so does the keeper. It goes away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Digs in a short ball, well directed too, Starc leaves it alone.
Just ahead of a length, well outside off, Starc plays and misses.
Going away from around off, a good length ball, run down to third man for a single.
Length delivery on off, Hazlewood pushes it defensively to covers.

Drinks break. What an hour of play here! Just what Test cricket is all about. The Indians have stormed their way back into the match. 23 runs scored and 5 wickets lost. Can't wait to see what is in store now. The pitch has become a minefield and the visitors have their work cut out, whenever they come out to bat that is. Also, Ishant Sharma is into the attack now.
FOUR! Any pure batsman would be proud of that shot. Cleanly hit. Full and just outside off, Starc stands his ground and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Cutting back in from a length, catches the inside edge of Hazlewood's bat as he gets cramped for room. It goes off his back leg and rolls towards covers. The batsmen take a single.
Shami throws it fuller now, literally asking Hazlewood to go for it. He does so too, but only connects with thin air.
Outside off on a good length, Josh plays and misses.
Off the mark finally. The Perth crowd cheers on. Starc works this down in front of mid-wicket and jogs across to the other end.
17 balls faced now and Starc is yet to get off the mark. Shami bowls a length delivery on off, it comes and then moves away late. Starc plays and misses.
Stays on the back foot and keeps it out on the off side.
Goes for the yorker but just misses his mark as he ends up dishing a full toss on leg. Hazlewood offers a straight bat in response.
Short ball down the leg side, Josh has nothing to do with it.
Taps this one in front of cover from inside his crease.
Just behind a length, outside off, Hazlewood loosely plays at it and is unable to get bat on it.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Hazlewood looks to steer the cut behind point but doesn't connect.
Comes from around the wicket and digs in another short one, Starc ducks and evades. Another testing over from Shami comes to an end.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in.

OUT! Lyon is dismissed next ball. Shami gets his man, his sixth of the innings. He is all smiles. Back of a length and it's angling in on middle and leg, Nathan Lyon backs away and is cramped for room once more. He looks to cut it over point, does so but hands an easy enough catch to Hanuma Vihari at cover-point who is at the edge of the circle. He comes running in and takes it well. Australia are essentially 250/9 here.
Lyon was caught on the helmet on the previous delivery and is receiving medical attention. Don't want to take any risks with head injuries.

Whoa! That's got to hurt! Shami comes charging in and pounds it in hard, Lyon looks to pull but the ball has too much pace on it. He misses and cops a blow on the helmet. Virat Kohli and some more Indian players walk up to him to see if he's okay, looks to be alright but it's good to make sure.
On the fourth stump line, Nathan pushes it away on the off side.
Cramps the batsman for room this time. Nicely done. Lyon backs away to cut it again, but doesn't have the space to do so.
FOUR! Boundary for Nathan Lyon and the crowd goes wild. Short and wide outside off, he stands tall and cuts it well over point to find the fence. The lead reaches 250 now.
Similar ball, same result. It's on here in Perth!
Maybe attacking the stumps would be better for the Indian pacers. Bumrah with a length ball outside off, Starc swings and misses.
Shortish delivery cutting back in, Starc hangs his bat and gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, left alone.
Lyon moves inside the line and comfortably works it square on the leg side for a single.

The situation is clear now. The Aussies are going to go for everything and the Indians will try to exploit that. Bumrah bowls this just outside off, Lyon swings looking to clear the stadium, but fails in his attempt.
Outside off, once more Mitch makes zero connection with the ball.
He's just tempting the batsman now. Hurls it offering a lot of width outside off, Starc throws his bat at it looking to crash it through the covers but misses altogether.
Good length delivery well outside off, Starc goes after it and misses.
Brings it in closer to the off stick, Starc awkwardly plays at it. Gets an inside edge which falls down beside the off stump.
Fuller this time, outside off, a play and a miss from the batsman.
India breathing fire here. Shami comes from around the wicket and hurls it outside off, slightly short in length, Starc arches back and lets it be.
FOUR LEG BYES! Length delivery down the leg side, Lyon looks to glance it away but it goes off his thigh pad. It races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Outswinging full toss outside off, Lyon fails to make connection once more. Pant dives to his right and makes a good save.
Quite full and outside off, Lyon looks to put bat on ball but fails to do so.
Nathan Lyon is the new batsman in.

OUT! GONE! This one has kept really low. Can't say what will happen on this surface now. Bumrah bowls a length ball in line of the stumps, instead of rising like the other ones, it keeps low and Cummins is done in by this. No chance of keeping it out as it goes under his bat. The stumps are rattled and that's another wicket down.

Ripper! The pitch has woken up from its slumber. Doing all sorts of things. Length ball on middle and it shapes away late, beats the outside edge of Cummins' hanging bat and goes into the keeper's gloves.
Short ball banged in, ducked and evaded by Cummins.
Woah! Another miss by Starc outside the off stump. Shami is spitting fire here at the moment.
Another play and miss outside off. The ball is acting really wild here and Pant does well to collect this diving to his left.
Beaten! This one is short and outside off once more, Starc looks to feel for the ball and he cannot get bat on it.
Another short one outside off and Starc lets it go.
Bouncer outside off and Starc just lets it fly through.
Australia in some trouble here. The objective will be to set a target close to 300. Will they be able to though?
Mitchell Starc is the next man in.

OUT! The match may have just turned on its head here! Shami has five wickets in the innings. His fourth five-wicket haul in Test cricket and the second in this year. The ball is on a short length and rares up out of nowhere. Khawaja is really taken aback by the ball and gets a glove as he tries to fend it off. Pant collects another easy catch behind the stumps and Khawaja is gone for a good innings of 72. 8 runs and 3 wickets after Lunch. Australia are essentially 241/7 here.
Wide! Short ball but it's too high and down the leg side, wide signalled.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Short ball, pulled away into the leg side for a single.
Another one that is left alone by the left-hander outside off.
Well outside off stump, left alone by the batsman.
Fuller this time and Khawaja pushes it to the cover region.
Short outside off, it is defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Ouch! Nasty! Cummins looks to duck out of the way of this bouncer but the ball doesn't bounce as much he thinks it will. Gets him on the grill but Cummins looks okay to continue.
Excellent running! The ball is full outside over, driven by Khawaja through the covers. The cover fielder gives chase but the batsmen come back for three.
Slightly fuller outside off, Khawaja is ahead to this and defends it to cover.
Short and aimed at the ribs, pushed off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Outside off and almost a half-tracker. Khawaja sways and lets it go.
No hat-trick for Shami. Length ball outside off, comes off the outside edge and runs to the left of point for a single. Good ball first up to Pat Cummins, who was feeling for it.
The second new ball has been taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball on off, kept out from within the crease.
In the off stump channel as Bumrah serves it on a length, Usman makes a decent leave.
Full length ball on the stumps, driven to mid on. Won't get any run for it.
Good length delivery close to off, it's tapped down on the off side.
Comes from around the wicket and hurls it well outside off, Khawaja plays away from the body and gets beaten.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end. Also, Pat Cummins is the new man in to bat.

OUT! Two in two! The whole Indian team is pumped up now. Excellent from Shami! Welcomes Aaron Finch with a short of a length skidder on middle and leg. Finch looks like he is in two minds here, also a little worried about his finger. He goes for the flick and gets a feather off his glove. It is gleefully accepted by Pant down the leg side. The Indians celebrate and Australia are suddenly 192/6 from 192/4. Mohammed Shami will be on a hat-trick next over.
Aaron Finch has returned.

OUT! What a ripper! An absolute brute of a delivery and the Aussie captain has to go. This is a bouncer and Paine has nothing he can do. It is aimed straight at his head and he tries to fend it off while jumping. The ball comes off his glove and lobs up for a simple catch to Virat Kohli who comes running in to his left from second slip. The Aussie skipper has to leave but Paine has done his job here, one would say. A great start to the session though for India. The Aussies lead by 235 now.
Wide! Too high! Bouncer and on middle, Paine ducks under it but the ball was still too high over the head of the batsman.
Outside off and comes in a bit after landing, Paine shoulders arms as it well away from his off pole.
Short of a length delivery, Tim Paine stands tall and defends it on the off side.
Another length ball, but it is on the pads. Played with soft hands to mid-wicket and a quick single is taken. First runs of the second session.
Around the wicket, on length and just outside off. Khawaja defends it to cover.

The players and umpires are making their way back onto the ground. Should be a really interesting passage of play this. Usman Khawaja takes strike on the first delivery. It will be bowled by Mohammed Shami.
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

Tim Paine and Usman Khawaja carried on from where they left off on Day 3. The latter reached the half-century mark too in the course of this session. The overrate has been good and the one positive for India would be the fact that they haven't leaked runs here. But, now they will have to kind of dance to Australia's tunes, unless something changes drastically. The best they can do is to try and keep the scoring rate down. What can we expect from the second session? Whatever it is, it should be really fun. Stay tuned with us for the post-Lunch session that will begin in some time.

A very slow session but could be a match-defining one. 30 overs, 58 runs and no wickets lost. The lead has swelled up to 233. The Aussies are firmly in the driver's seat now. They can step up the gas and go in overdrive mode once they are back, and look to score as many quick runs as possible. With the declaration on the back of their minds, Tim Paine and co. would like to bat India out of the game and also ensure they have enough time left to bowl out the visitors in the fourth innings. The Indian pacers have toiled hard since morning, even beat the outside edges on numerous occasions but the rub of green was in Australia's favour, although it would do well not to take anything away from the way the two batsmen out in the middle have played.
Paine defends this one calmly to mid-wicket and walks off towards his partner as LUNCH IS CALLED ON DAY 4!
Flicked off the pads towards square leg in the circle.
Drifting onto the pads once more, Khawaja works it off his pads to deep fine leg for a run.
Short of a length and moving into the body, UK plays it off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, Usman shoulders his arms to it once more.
Well outside off and left alone by Khawaja.
Ishant Sharma to bowl the last over before Lunch.
In the channel outside off, Paine leaves this length delivery alone and ends the over.
Paine stays inside his crease and pushes it into the covers. Dot ball.
Banged in short, accurate from Shami, Tim lets it be.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length and just around off, kept out safely.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed to point for a single.
Left alone by the batsman to end the over.
Flatter ball on off, Paine is in his crease and defends it off his back foot.
Wide outside off and left alone by the batsman.
FOUR! Well outside off and Paine drives this beautifully in the gap wide of deep cover. All too easy for the hosts now.
Very full and driven down the ground to long off for a run.
Full outside off, driven to deep cover for a single by Paine.
Length ball on off stump, defended with soft hands to short cover. Maiden over.
Another ball outside off, left by the batsman yet again.
Well outside off and the batsman chooses to leave the ball.
Slightly fuller on off stump, Usman comes ahead and defends it into the ground.
Outside off and left alone by the batsman.
Outside off and the ball moves away after landing. Khawaja fails to put bat on ball as he tries to defend it.
Short and quick on off and middle, Paine defends it towards mid-wicket. What a quick over.
Well outside off, left alone this time.
Shorter one on middle, defended from within the crease by the Australian skipper.
Flatter outside off, defended by Paine to point.
Outside off, left alone by Paine.
Full on middle, Khawaja walks into the shot towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Outside off and left alone by the Australian skipper.
FOUR! Short and a rank poor ball well outside off. Paine cuts and cuts hard to the right of third man. He had no chance of stopping that one.
A carbon copy of the previous ball. Paine sways out late yet again.
Good bouncer just outside off, Paine pulls out of his pull pretty late.
Outside off again, played with soft hands towards point.
Length ball on off stump, Paine is slightly ahead as he defends it back to the bowler.
Mohammed Shami returns to the attack.
Driven through the covers by Paine for a single as he keeps strike.
Another shorter one from Vihari, Khawaja brings out another cut but this time in the gap. Single taken.
Cut away by Khawaja to backward point.
On the front foot and defended into the ground by the leftie.
Outside off, driven by Khawaja. Kohli, at cover, dives and stops what looked like a certain single.
Full toss, Paine drives to long off for a run.
Full ball on middle, pushed to deep mid on and Paine keeps strike for the next over.
Effort ball that doesn't rise too much outside off. The skipper sways away and lets this one go.
Short of a length ball outside off, defended by Paine on the back foot.
Full and quick, Usman flicks it away to square leg for a single.
Short of a length ball on middle, Khawaja jumps and defends this towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, Paine looks to drive but the ball goes off the inside half towards deep square leg for a single.
Another single to end the over and the Australian skipper keeps strike.
Oooh! Keeps a little low and Paine is beaten outside off as he tries to drive this ball.
Khawaja drives this through the gap to deep cover. The batsmen take a single and it brings up the 50-run stand between these two. It is off 177 deliveries but a very good one for the Aussies.
Left alone outside off.
Flatter outside off, Khawaja cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Wide outside off and full, Paine prods ahead and drives to deep cover for a single.
Another variation to end the over. Slower one but read by the batsman and he lets it go outside off.
Bouncer! Khawaja ducks under it.
Left alone outside off at the last moment by Usman. Good over so far from Bumrah.
This one goes the other way and Khawaja is beaten on the outside as he tries to keep it out off the back foot.
On a good length and just outside off, the ball comes in very late but it is left alone by the batsman. Well left in the end.
Very full and on off, Khawaja does well as he digs it out towards mid on.
It's gone the wrong way a bit actually. Lands around off and spins off the crack with some extra bounce, Paine is beaten completely.
Well outside off, left alone.
Short, wide and outside off, Khawaja rocks on the back foot and cuts it square through point. It won't go all the way, but it's good enough to fetch him three runs.
Tossed up with a lot of room on offer outside off, Paine drives it through the covers for a run.
Plays this with the spin and pushes this away square on the off side. A quick single is stolen.
Spinning away from outside off, easy leave for the left-hander.
Another forward defensive stroke from Paine to end the over.
Well outside off, Paine pushes ahead and defends it into the ground.

Yorker! Almost had him there. Paine is surprised by this one and is saved from being plumb LBW by a thick inside edge. Loud appeal from the Indians but the umpire has spotted the ball going off the willow there.
Another short of a length ball, Paine defends but doesn't look too comfortable. Does well in the end to stave it off.
Short of a length, defended by the skipper off his back foot.
Bouncer to begin the over, the ball flies over the head of Paine as he misses his hook.
Jasprit Bumrah to have a go with the ball.
Wide outside off and cut away wide of point for a single.
Flatter one bowled outside off, the Australian skipper lets the ball go through.
Well outside off and keeps low, Paine tries to cut it but the ball goes below the under edge.
Fuller in length, Khawaja drives through the covers for a single.
Another one that is outside off and Usman lets it go.
Outside off and left alone by Khawaja.
Hanuma Vihari is into the attack now.
Driven and driven well. Umesh goes full and Khawaja drives this beautifully through the covers. The ball doesn't reach the fence but the batsmen come back three.
Left alone outside the off stump.
WIDE! Too short and well above the head of the batsman. Pant jumps and stops this one. Very athletic.
Delivered well outside off, almost near the wide line. The batsman is disinterested and leaves it.
Khawaja defends this ball towards cover-point off the back foot.
Closer this time but still not close enough to make the batsman play.
Very wide outside off, left alone by Khawaja.

14th Test fifty for Usman Khawaja. A solid knock. He's been tested in his stay in the middle, but he's battling it out. Showed good temperament and grit. He works this ball in front of square leg and comes back for three runs.
That's kept really low. Khawaja is lucky it wasn't in line of the stumps. Going away outside off, a length ball, the southpaw tries to defend but it goes under his bat.
Leans ahead to this fuller length ball and pushes it to mid on.
Brings it in closer, a tight line, another defensive shot in response.
Shaping away from around off, on a length, Khawaja plays away from his body and gets beaten in the process.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, Usman Khawaja is rock solid in defense as he keeps it out from within the crease.
Short of a length ball on middle, Paine misses the ball and gets hit on the thigh pad.
This is going down the leg side with the angle, left alone by the batsman.
Fuller on the pads, flicked away to deep square leg and batsmen pick up a single.
Left alone outside off by Khawaja.
Another short of a length ball on middle, almost similar to the previous one. It is off the pad and rolls on the leg side and the batsmen run through for one leg bye.
Short of a length ball and well it has come off a crack once more. It bounces out of nowhere and Paine is not ready for this one. He gets hit on the glove. Has a surprised look on his face.
Going away with the natural angle, slightly fullish in length, left alone.
Full delivery on off stump, driven straight to mid off.
Fraction straight in line on this occasion, it's worked away on the leg side for a single.

That is an absolute jaffa! What a ball from Ishant Sharma. It's gone off the crack once again. He's been trying that for a while, got it almost perfect here. He angles it in on middle and off and then it straightens up nicely. Paine is squared up while defending and beaten all ends up as the ball goes past the outside edge and the off stump as well. Beautiful. Nothing the Aussie skipper could have done about that.
Once again it's well outside off, on a good length, left alone once more.
On the sixth stump line, no shot offered.

Drinks break. This has been quite a slow-moving hour of play with just 19 runs in 13 overs, but Australia will be really happy about not losing a wicket so far. The lead is up to 194. The sun is also out contrary to the forecast which was for it to be cloudy. Batting hasn't looked difficult so far.
Fuller on middle, Khawaja comes ahead and drives to mid on.
Yet another quick single, Tim just plays this on the leg side with soft hands and rushes to the other end.
Dropped down on the off side by the southpaw with soft hands. The 150 is up for the hosts. The lead is now 193.
Outside off and cut away off the back foot to third man for another single.
Fuller and on the pads again, worked towards mid-wicket for a run by Usman.
Short length ball which is going down leg with the angle, Khawaja tries to whip it away but misses the ball completely.
Straying down the pads, it is flicked away but straight to square leg.
Full length delivery on off and middle, Paine just defends it back to the bowler. Ishant has some words to say to the batsman.
Paine is slightly forward in defense on this occasion to a fuller one on off stump.
Length ball on middle, the skipper defends it watchfully as he lets the ball come onto the bat.
Short of a length on the off stump, Usman drops it on the off side with soft hands and picks up a quick single.
Well outside off and left alone by the left-hander.
Usman works it off his pads and to deep square leg for a single.
Khawaja comes onto the front foot and defends this ball on off stump confidently.
Oooh! Another play and miss here! Short ball outside off, Khawaja tries to pull this but misses yet again. Almost reminiscent of the Marsh dismissal.
Solid defensive shot right back down the ground.
Beaten again! This one is outside off and comes in with the angle. Khawaja tries to defend it on the front foot but misses the ball.
Length ball outside off, beautifully cut away by Paine to deep backward point for a single.
A bumper outside off, Khawaja thinks about the pull but doesn't go for it and lets it go in the end.
Left alone outside off stump again.
Well outside off, Khawaja raises his arms to let it go.

Seems like a ploy here bowling at the pads, with a leg slip in position. Paine tries to work this short of a length ball away to square leg but misses the ball. It goes off the thigh pad towards square leg and the batsmen run through for a leg bye.
Going well down leg, the skipper just watches it go through. No need to play at those.
Well defended by Paine. Right off the middle of the bat.
Ishant Sharma is now into the attack.
This one is left alone again outside off by the batsman after gauging the movement.
Again the ball is outside off and Khawaja shoulders his arms to it.
Around the wicket, left alone by the batsman well outside off.
Length ball on off and middle, Paine turns it down on the leg side for a single.
Closer to the off stump but still not close enough to make the batsman play. Leaves it alone.
Well outside off to start off with, left alone by the Aussie skipper. Good carry here.
Umesh Yadav is the first bowling change of the morning.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Too far outside off, no way Tim Paine will play at it.
A touch short outside off, run down to short third man. No run taken.
Straightening up after going off the seam, on a length around off, Khawaja taps it down in front of point and scampers to the other end.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery close to off, Usman hangs back and keeps it out.
Wide outside off, left alone to end the over.
Yet another bouncer, the batsman ducks under it and lets it go through.
It is a bouncer but well outside off, left alone by Paine.

So close! A run out opportunity. The ball is a short one aimed at the head, Khawaja fends it off on the leg side and runs through for a quick single. Bumrah on his followthrough chases the ball, picks it up, turns and has a shy at the non-striker's end. The ball misses the stumps and the batsman survives. Was a goner had the ball hit.
On off stump, Usman comes ahead and drives towards mid on.
Yet another play and miss from Khawaja. This one lands on a length and straightens just a bit after landing but it is enough to beat the outside edge.
Much better from the Australian skipper, gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it.
Well outside off, Paine tries to cut the ball but misses it completely. Didn't need to go chasing after this one.
Slightly fuller, Tim drives it back down the ground on his front foot. Shami tries to reach the ball but it is too far. The ball though hits the non-striker who was trying to get back in the crease.
Another effort delivery but this one is going down leg and Paine moves out of the way and lets it go.
Outside off and comes in slightly but the batsman gauges the movement and then shoulders arms at it.
Bouncer, Paine ducks under it and lets it fly through.
Back to being on off stump, Khawaja looks to push it on the off side but the ball gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Well outside off and left alone. This has come off a crack it seems and it moves square and Pant dives full length to his left to take this.
Left alone outside off.
Good length ball just outside off, Khawaja takes a small stride forward and defends it back down the ground.
On off stump, defended by Usman standing tall.
A good length ball, this one takes off suddenly from a crack but Paine adjusts well and fends it off towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Oooh! An edge again but again soft hands and the ball doesn't carry to second slip. Good over from Shami. Maiden.
Left alone as it served outside off.
Khawaja stands tall and defends this ball on a short length off his back foot.
Well outside off and Usman wants nothing to do with this one.
A good length ball on off stump, he pushes it to mid off. No run though.
Outside off and Khawaja is beaten once more. He was in his crease as he tried to defend it but the ball shaped away in the end to miss his outside edge by a whisker.
Beaten! Served outside off on a length, Paine comes ahead to defend but is beaten for pace.

FOUR! It is edged but Paine takes his bottom hand off the blade and the ball doesn't carry to second slip. Instead it goes to his right and he dives but can't reach it. It runs all the way to the fence for a boundary.
Left alone outside the off stump.
Just outside off, Paine guides it with soft hands to gully. Tried to find the gap between slips and gully but the ball goes straight to the fielder.
Another front foot defense from the skipper to a length ball. It is off the middle of the bat. Meanwhile, we see Finch all padded up which is good news for the hosts as he has been deemed fit to bat.
Good ball from Bumrah, length and on off and middle stump. Paine defends it comfortably though.
A solid front foot defense to end this over to a good length delivery just outside off.
Khawaja chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump once more.
This ball is served well outside off and is left alone by the left-hander.
On off stump again, Usman takes a step down the wicket and defends it towards mid off.
Closer to the off stump on a good length, Khawaja defends coming half forward.
Well outside off to start off with and left alone by the batsman.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
Outside off on a length and calmly defended away to cover-point.
Outside off and left alone by the skipper.
Aimed at the hips, Khawaja jumps and works it away to deep square leg to get his first run of the day. The ball did not bounce as much as Usman expected so he did well to adjust there.
Solid defense on this occasion to a short of a length delivery on off and middle.
Good length ball outside off, Khawaja guides it with soft hands to gully.
Outside off on a short length, Tim Paine drops it with soft hands on the off side and gets to the other end. First run of the day.
The batsmen, fielding team and the umpires walk out to the middle. We are all set to go. Tim Paine to take strike on the first ball of the day to be bowled by Jasprit Bumrah.

Ajinkya Rahane in an interview with Michael Howard says that the team is looking to stay in the present, and feels they have to bowl well in the first hour. About his own batting, he says that he was looking to play one ball at a time whilst also looking to attack at the same time. Feels that it was easy to bat on that wicket if the batsmen left balls outside off. He adds that it helped him to bat with Virat Kohli and says he is a world-class batsman. Says communication is the key when he bats with his skipper. On his sojourns to Australia, he says that he came here first in 2011 and he loves coming here and playing as it is always a challenge. Walking up to the pitch, he has a look and suggests that it is better to trust your defense and just play on the merit of the ball. On his opinion about the controversial catch yesterday, he says that it is in the past and the team just wants to concentrate on the present.

Michael Vaughan with the pitch report points out that the cracks on the wicket have widened even more than yesterday. Also adds that the rough patch outside the right-handed batsmen's off stump has become all the more prominent due to Indian seamers bowling around the wicket to the left-handers of Australia, feels Nathan Lyon should be licking his lips waiting to bowl on this. Ends by saying it was a wonderful year for Test cricket as there have been good pitches with an even contest between bat and ball and it has been no different here at Perth.

The visitors will look to restrict Australia's lead to anything under 220-230 as a score in excess will surely be difficult to achieve while batting fourth, especially against a Nathan Lyon who is in red-hot form at the moment. That said, India do have Virat Kohli in their team and as Michael Clarke said on air, you give them an extra 30 runs when you have him. So, it all boils down to this! Surely by the end of the day, we will have a little more clarity as to whether it is going to be 0-2 or 1-1 as a draw looks highly unlikely in this game. Join us for action which begins in a while.

Welcome to Day 4 of this intriguing second Test of the Border-Gavaskar trophy.  It will be safe to say that, even though the hosts have their noses slightly ahead in the game, it is pretty much delicately poised and can be back to even should India get early wickets. The weather forecast for today says that it should be partly cloudy which will be a relief for the players as there will be pleasant playing conditions. Thus there is a chance that the ball might do things in the air and with it already moving square off the wicket, it won't be easy to bat today.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Usman Khawaja and Tim Paine are unbeaten at the close of play and will look to score some quick runs on Day 4. India, on the other hand, will believe that a quick wicket or two will keep them in the hunt. At the start of the day, we said that we would have a fair idea as to which side this Test would be heading but we have been proved wrong. If at all, we can say that the hosts have their noses slightly ahead, but they cannot afford to relax. So much to look forward to, join us for Day 4 action from Perth at 1020 local (0220 GMT). Goodbye, cheers!

Earlier in the day, the Indians batted for a little over one session and added 111 runs to their overnight score before being bowled out, handing a lead of 43 to their opposition. The Indian skipper got to his ton during that period but once he was gone, there wasn't much resistance shown by the remaining batsmen. Nathan Lyon once again picked up five wickets. The Australian openers came out to bat and faced a spirited Indian bowling attack with the new ball but managed to survive till Tea, or maybe just about the last ball if you consider the fact that the last ball before Tea was the one that got Finch out injured. He did not return for the last session but his replacement, Usman Khawaja batted really well and remained unbeaten till the end of the day. He kept losing partners but did not lose his concentration, although there was one delivery that went off his edge during Vihari's bowling that Rahane couldn't get a hand to.

What a day of Test cricket we have had here! Australia finish the day with a lead of 175 runs. They have 6 wickets left with Finch expected to bat tomorrow as there is no major damage on his finger, shown by the scans. Usman Khawaja has looked really good at the crease and held onto his wicket tightly. He weathered the storm when the ball was doing all sorts of things and now, he looks well set to make a big score. Coming to the Indian bowling, they have not let the Aussies stitch a big partnership so far and have been picking up wickets at regular intervals. They will need to continue to do so as anything over 250 will be really tough to chase on this pitch.
Hurls it in the region outside off, Usman feels for it and gets beaten. Almost edged it. That will be it, Stumps on Day 3.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Movement back into the batsman, Paine tries driving through the line but it takes the inside half of his blade and rolls towards mid on for a run.

Huge shout for a catch! Not given. Ishant gets a length delivery to tail down the leg side. Paine tries to flick but seems to have missed. However, there is some noise which triggers a big appeal from Pant and company. Umpire Kumar Dharmasena remains unmoved. A little bit of thought given to the DRS but nothing much. Virat Kohli says something as he goes back to his fielding position. Tim Paine is seen smiling after that. Hot Spot shows us that the noise was of the ball clipping the pads of Paine. Fine decision.
Good line from Ishant. He is once again right on the money. Fuller and around off, shaping back in, Tim is well forward in defense.
Starts this spell with a good length ball on middle and leg, Paine stays back to defend it near his pads.
Ishant Sharma is back on as well.
Well outside off on this occasion, Khawaja raises his arms and lets the ball go through.

Just short! The ball is outside off and Khawaja edges it behind while pushing inside the line. Rahane at gully is ahead but the ball falls just in front of him. Umesh looks up to the skies as if he is asking for some luck.
Dropped onto the off side with soft hands by the skipper. He wants the single and gets it.
Paine tries to guide this good length ball to third man but the ball goes straight to backward point.
Short length ball on top of off stump, Paine defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Outside off and left alone by Tim Paine.
Bowling change. Umesh Yadav is back for another burst before Stumps.

EDGED AND FOUR! A chance goes begging! The ball is short and well outside off, Vihari has been bowling this line and length continuously. Khawaja goes for the cut this time and gets the outside edge. It goes quickly to Rahane at slip who is late to react and cannot reach the ball. It goes all the way for four.
Way outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Outside off and Usman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shoulders arms to this one outside off.
Fuller this time outside off, Khawaja comes ahead and defends into the ground.
Flatter outside off, left alone. Pant from behind the wickets asks him to keep bowling it there.
Short ball aimed at the body of Paine. The Aussie skipper does well to get out of the way. Goes to Pant at a good height.
Bouncer outside off, left alone by the skipper.
The batsman goes back in his crease and defends it back with the straight bat.
Fuller on this occasion, Paine looks to drive through the covers but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat to mid on.
FOUR! It's short and wide outside off. Paine times the ball and gets it into the gap behind point. What a lovely shot at the fag end of the day!
Well outside off on a length, left alone by Tim Paine.
Left alone again and another over has been run through by Vihari. Very quick.
Goes for the cut this time to this short ball outside off but finds a deepish gully. No run.
Another one that is left alone outside the off stump.
Shouldered arms to again, outside off.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Short of a length and a little spin, Paine gets the inner half and the ball goes towards mid-wicket as the batsmen run through for one.
Well wide outside off, left alone by the batter.
Short of a length ball outside off, Usman goes back and defends it with a straight bat.
Almost a carbon copy of the previous ball, sways out of the way again.
Now this one is on the same length and it bounces over his head outside off. Usman lets it fly through.

OUCH! Nasty! Looks like the ball has been lost by the batsman. He gets hit on the glove and luckily for him, the ball lands right down there on the pitch. Takes his glove off and has a look. Seems to be okay to continue. Shami is getting some consistent extra lift from the surface. Tough conditions for batting.
Short ball outside off, Khawaja is deep in his crease as he defends.
This ball takes the inside edge as Paine looks to punch this off the back foot. The ball goes over the stumps and goes towards shortish fine leg.
Loopy one outside off stump, Paine defends it with soft hands.
Paine comes ahead to this one and defends it.
Flatter delivery outside off, pushed by the batsmen to covers.
Left alone by Tim outside off.
Outside off, Paine defends it towards cover.
Outside off and Paine pushes it towards point and gets a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Paine plays it down from the crease to point.
Shami is steaming in here. Lets out a skiddy delivery, a bit on the shorter side around off, Paine drops his wrists and leans back to allow it through to the keeper.
Snorter! Uneven bounce from a shorter length around off and Paine is caught in an awkward position. Fails to keep it out and takes a blow on his body. Tim shows no pain.
Serves it on a good length around off, Paine gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Tim Paine is in next.

OUT! Caught at third man! Head falls to the bait, once more! Shami serves this ball wide outside off on the shorter side, Head takes the bait and goes for the slash. The ball rockets off the top edge and goes to Ishant at the boundary, who is stationed especially for that at third man. Sharma moves back a bit and grabs the catch safely. Head will be super disappointed with this shot as he fell in the exact same way in the first innings. That time the bowler was Ishant and the fielder was Shami and now it is vice-versa. India have got a breakthrough at a crucial juncture. Australia are effectively 163-4 now.
Mohammed Shami comes onto bowl.
Once again a full toss by Vihari and Head calmly eases it down through mid on for a run.
This one slips out of his hand and Khawaja knocks a full toss down to long on for one.
Probably a slider outside off, Khawaja allows it through to the keeper.
Goes straight with his drive and pushes a full ball down to long off for a run.
Fuller and on off, Head plays the drive off his front foot but finds the cover fielder.
Flighted delivery landing full outside off, a handsome cover drive by Khawaja for a single. Australia ahead by 160 runs.
Another play and a miss off Bumrah's bowling. The ball is on off and swerves away after landing. Head looks to cut from the front foot but misses the ball. A slight appeal but nothing major.
Wide on the off side and Head sways out of the way. The ball swings a long way after passing the stumps and Pant dives to his left to catch it. Good take.
Fuller this time, defended back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, defended from within the crease.
Full and outside off, Khawaja drives this one and Vijay at cover-point misfields and allows the ball through his legs. The batsmen come back for three, great running. Virat Kohli is not happy.
Rattling length outside off, Khawaja jumps and defends it onto the pitch.
A leave outside off to end the over. Maiden.
This time it is on the stumps, defended by Head towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, fourth leave in a row.
Left alone again.
Another one floated outside off stump, no shot offered.
Well outside off and left alone by Head.
Full and outside off, good leave by the batsman.
Solid defense on this one outside off.
This ball moves late after landing on a length and beats the bat of Khawaja as he tries to defend.
Left alone outside off.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja plays it with soft hands towards gully.
Outside off on a length, Head does well to guide it to deep point and gets a single. With that, he also moves to the 2nd position in the list of leading run-getters in this series.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Once again Vihari serves a shortish delivery outside off, Khawaja delays his shot a bit and runs it wide of short backward point. The fielder chases it down and they take a couple.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and cuts it straight to the point fielder yet again.
Flighted delivery outside off, left alone by Khawaja.
Width on offer outside off, Usman chases it and plays the cut but finds the shortish backward point fielder.
Beaten! Quicker and shorter on off, skidding off the surface, Khawaja goes back to cut but it's too close to his body and hence he misses.

Another cracker served by Bumrah! The ball is short of a length and suddenly moves after landing on a crack and changes its direction. Head is not ready for it and sways out of it at the last moment. Lots of smiles around seeing the ball misbehave like that. Trust me, you wouldn't like it if you were batting there.
Well outside off, left alone.
Well outside off and Head goes chasing again! The ball moves away at the last moment and misses the willow once more. Bumrah can't believe what is happening.
Another ball short of a length, but this time Head defends it well.
What a ripper! Rares of a length and beats the outside edge of Head. So close but the batsman is safe.
Around the wicket and on off, Head stands tall and defends.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on for another spell.
Allowed it through again. So just like Vihari's last over, five balls were left alone in this one also.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Khawaja is restraining himself from playing the square cut. There is a backward point fielder standing a few steps up waiting for any mishit.
Tossed up and wide outside off, Usman has nothing to do with it.
Loopy full ball on off, Usman leans forward in defense.
Short and wide outside off, left alone again by Khawaja.
Bowls it wide outside off, it's on the shorter side, the batsman makes an easy leave.
Head rocks back in his crease and defends it back to the bowler.
Well outside off and left alone by Travis Head.

In the air! But lands in no man's land. Very lucky for the batsman. Short on middle, Khawaja looks to swivel and pull it away to deep square leg. The ball gets the top edge and goes high in the air. Pant gives chase and a fielder from fine leg comes in but the ball falls between both of them. A slice of luck in favour of the batsman again.

FOUR! Off the edge and four again. The ball was on a length outside off and straightened a bit after pitching. Khawaja did well to remove his bottom hand off the blade and the ball went to the fence all along the ground. The lead is above 150 now.
Well outside off and Usman chases at it. Needless from him, could have let that go.
Outside off on a length, Khawaja pushes it to covers.
One more leave in this over by Head. Showing a lot of patience.
Tossed up delivery wide outside off, Head covers his stumps and allows it through.
Full and flighted outside off, driven firmly off the front foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter and wide outside off, once again Travis leaves it alone.
Quicker and outside off, left alone.
Flighted and wide outside off, the batsman takes a stride forward before making a leave. Pant is quite chirpy behind the wickets and wants Vihari to keep bowling this line.
Hanuma Vihari is now onto bowl.
Oooh! This one keeps a tad low and goes under Khawaja's bat as he tries to defend. In fact, the batsman was a bit late to bring his bat down. Very close to the off stump.
Good length ball on middle and leg, it is placed towards mid-wicket for a run. Good batting, a single after the boundary.
FOUR! Wide outside off and Head throws his bat at it. The ball takes a thick part of the willow and flies over gully's head for four runs. Rahane leaps but cannot get his hands to it.
Wider outside off and the batsman leaves it alone.
Play and a miss! Fuller outside off, Head goes for the cover drive and is beaten on the outside edge.
Yadav comes around the wicket and bowls it well outside off, it is left alone.
Fuller outside off, driven well to cover. Good sound off the bat.
Short of a length and on off stump, Usman stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Length ball on off stump, defended from within the crease back to the bowler.
A little more towards the off stump, Khawaja plays it to mid on.
Full and on middle, this doesn't seem to be troubling Khawaja as he guides it away easily to deep mid-wicket for a couple. The 100 comes up for the hosts.

Drinks break. Another hour of this fascinating Test match has passed and the game is still hanging in balance. The Indian fast bowlers have put on an exhibition of classy pace bowling. They have been threatening and very penetrative. But they can't afford to relax as Australia's lead is crawling towards the 200-run mark. Khawaja seems to be in good touch. He, along with Head, will look to keep the Aussies unscathed till the end of day's play.
Fuller outside off, Head looks to drive but the ball gets the inside edge and goes to mid on.
Similar delivery and similarly defended.
A short ball on top of off stump. Head defends it back to the bowler.
Short ball wide on off, Travis cuts it away in the gap square on the off side for another couple.
Short and on off stump, Head defends it back to the bowler.
Wonderfully flicked away behind square leg by Head for a couple.
Another leave from Khawaja to end the over.
Well outside off, left alone by the left-hander.
Ishant is on the pads for the third ball in a row, Travis pushes it to deep mid-wicket for another run.
Drifts onto the pads yet again, Head connects the flick here and he gets a couple as it travels to deep square leg.
Going down leg off a good length, Head tries to flick it away but misses.
Very full and just outside off, Head defends it back to the bowler on a bounce.
Fuller ball just outside off, Khawaja tries to push this on the off side but the ball takes the inside half and rolls back to the bowler. End of the over.
Full and outside off, Usman drives it to mid off.
Wide outside off again, Khawaja cuts and cuts well. The fielder at third man comes around and cuts it out. The batsmen run two.
Very wide outside off, no need to play at those. Umesh needs to get his line right here.
Well outside off and left alone by the batsman.
The ball is on middle and Khawaja works it to mid-wicket.
Shoulders his arms to this one outside off.
Outside off and left alone by Head.

FOUR! He has touched the rope here. Sweetly timed by Head! Gets on the front foot and creams it through the covers. Bumrah gives chase and stops it inside the fence but while turning around he falters and his right foot touches the boundary cushions. Two free runs for Australia. Ishant looks upset.
This one comes in nice and full, Head is on the front foot and pushes it to mid off.
The first ball is outside off on a length and is left alone.
Travis Head walks out to bat, replacing Peter Handscomb. Two slips, two gullies and a short third man for the new batsman. Interesting field.

OUT! Trapped in front! An inspirational bowling change by Virat Kohli. He brings his speedster back into the attack and he delivers immediately. This Test match continues to thrill. Poor, very poor by Peter Handscomb. Ishant angles in a full length ball around off, it nips back in just a shade after landing and once again Peter tries to play it out from the comfort of his crease. A stride forward would have helped him there but it's completely absent. Also, his bat comes down at a wrong angle, so basically he has missed a pretty much straight ball to get hit on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up immediately. The Indians are celebrating the wicket and the crowd is also behind them. What an atmosphere!
Ishant Sharma is into the attack.
Goes onto the pads this time, Peter retains strike by flicking it away for a single behind square leg.
Fuller in length here, pushed away to mid on off the front foot.
Another ball on a length, Peter pushes it away towards point.
Fuller outside off, driven to cover-point.

FOUR! Goes short and well outside off this time, Handscomb goes back and pulls it away. Looks like a top edge, not entirely in control. The ball though lands in no-man's land and trickles away to the fence behind square leg.
Beaten! It's full and outside off, Handscomb should have been forward to this but decides to stay back and flirt inside the line. You won't succeed with a static footwork.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Strays onto the pads on the last ball of the over, the ball is worked away to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Beaten! This is a replay of the first ball and once again, the ball misses the outside edge. Really good bowling from Jasprit.
Another defensive shot with a straight bat off the back foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman being deep in his crease.

FOUR! Tries to go full this time but strays onto the pads. Khawaja glances it very fine and all the way for a boundary. A very good shot. The keeper dives to his right but the ball is just too far from him. This boundary also brings up 2000 runs for him while batting at number three.
Crackerjack of a delivery! The ball is on a length and tails away very late. Khawaja who looks to defend is completely beaten by this one and the ball thuds into the keeper's gloves. Unplayable.

FOUR! Outside edge but it flies over slip. Short ball outside off, Handscomb stands back in his crease and just flashes hard at it. The ball goes off the thick edge and rushes to the third man boundary. The slip cordon can just go and fetch the ball back.
Aimed at the hips, Khawaja flicks it away behind square leg for a run.
A good bouncer, aimed at the head. Usman ducks under it and lets it go through.
Length ball wide outside off, shoulders his arms again.
Well left outside the off stump.
Back of a length again to Khawaja, he jumps on his toes and defends it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Bumrah goes wide of the crease and darts in a full length ball on middle and leg. Handscomb gets across the stumps a bit and neatly deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Handscomb keeps his weight on the back foot and blocks it to the off side.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Clipped the thigh pad. Good length delivery on middle and leg, going down with the angle, Peter tries flicking but misses. It deflects off his thigh pad and goes behind to the keeper.
This one is angled into the batsman. Fuller in length and on middle, Handscomb plays it out from the crease to the on side.
Sharp delivery. On a length around off and skidding back in, Khawaja gets forward and closes the face of the bat as he plays it towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Short, quick one on off and middle. Well defended by Handscomb from the back foot.
Peter Handscomb is the new batsman for Australia. This is a crunch moment in this Test match.

OUT! Marsh is gone! The whole Indian team looks pumped up. A short ball on middle, Marsh looks to pull but is too early into the shot. The ball takes the under edge on its way through and Pant takes it comfortably. The umpire signals that the batsman is out and Virat Kohli is super excited. He also gives some kind of a send-off with a few words and actions. Suddenly, the game has come alive. Australia are effectively 107/2.
Bouncer from Shami, Marsh ducks under it.
Another leave outside off that follows the previous one. This is bowled from over the wicket.
Left alone outside off.
FOUR! A half and half shot there. Neither the cut nor the drive to this short one outside off. Takes a thick part of the blade and flies over Rahane at gully, all the way to the rope.
A good end to the over, left alone well outside off.
Back foot defense from inside the crease.
Another quickie that jumps off of a good length, Usman plays it to square leg after getting above the bounce.

Ouch! Painful again. A short of a length ball, Khawaja misses his defense and gets hit on his right thigh. Looks like the ball missed the thigh pad and Khawaja walks away in a bit of pain. Takes a moment to gather himself. Replays show that the ball hit him above the thigh pad. There might be a bruise in the morning.
Landing on middle and jags back in after landing, Marsh works it away to fine leg and gets a single to get off the mark. Good ball, could have been LBW had he missed.
The ball doesn't carry through to the keeper! It is outside off and goes on a bounce to Pant as Marsh makes a leave.
Good delivery to end the over. On top of off stump but defended solidly. Maiden over.
Finally gets a ball above the stumps. Khawaja stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Fourth leave in a row as it's well outside off.
Well outside off again, Usman shoulders his arms.
Another ball that is outside off, left alone again. Excellent carry.
Outside off and left alone without any problems.
The ball pitches on middle and comes back in late. Marsh gets hit on the thigh pad but the appeal for LBW is cut short as it was too high. Amazing over.
Left alone by Shaun outside off.

What has happened here? Suddenly a lot of action! Marsh initially wanted to flick this on the leg side and leaves it very late. Pant is put off due to that as he didn't anticipate the ball coming to him. Fumbles while collecting. That wasn't too far away from the off pole.
Length ball on leg stump to start with, Marsh looks to play with soft hands but misses it.
Shaun Marsh is the new batsman.

OUT! Timberrrr... Bumrah provides the first breakthrough. Error in judgment on Harris' part. Once again he did all the hard work but failed to convert his start. It's a good length delivery landing just outside off and then it moves back in a hint with the angle. Marcus watches the line closely and then decides to make a leave. But to his surprise, the ball moves back in just enough to clip the off bail. Bumrah is delighted. Can India build on this breakthrough? The Australian lead is 102 runs.
Angling into the batsman from around off, Harris presses forward and works it with soft hands in the gap at mid-wicket. Good running between the wickets fetches them a couple of runs.
Fuller length delivery is angled in around off, Khawaja gets on the front foot and drives it to the right of mid off.
This one is bowled wide outside off, trying to tempt the batsman to play away from his body. Khawaja is very watchful though. He lets it be to the keeper.
A touch short and in the zone outside off, Khawaja shoulders arms.

Excellent delivery. Shami hits the good area finally. From 'round the wicket he goes wide of the crease and angles in a good length ball around off. Usman plays the trajectory but it nips away to beat the outside edge.

The Indian bowlers have not switched on post Tea. Poor line by Shami. Too straight and it's been easily worked off the pads. The ball rolls in front of square leg and they steal a couple of runs. Lead is now 100!
Serves it up and outside off, Harris leans forward just like Warner does and pushes it gently in the gap at covers for a run.
Outside off, left alone. 10 runs off the over. India cannot afford to be so loose.
Another one that takes the thick outside edge, the ball runs fine towards third man and the batsmen come back for two.
A shorter length ball, that Khawaja looks to pull. The ball comes off the inside edge and thuds into the pads.
Fuller outside off, Usman drives this one to the cover-point fielder.
FOUR! This is much, much better from Khawaja. On the hips, flicked away wristily and all the way to the fence. The fine leg fielder cannot get around to stop it.
FOUR! A thick outside edge on this fuller one outside off. The ball runs through the gap between slips and gully and goes all the way for four.
Fuller length ball, inside edge on to the pads as Marcus looks to drive this through covers. Could have easily dragged it on!

Another play and a miss from Harris. He looked to cut this one off the front foot but misses the ball again. Close to the outside edge, but no edge. Kohli is jumping in an appeal but there was nothing on it.
Ugly-looking swipe at this one well outside off. Harris misses the ball completely.
FOUR! Full and driven down the ground to the right of mid on. The ball races away to the fence. Full face presentation and lovely to watch.
Another one outside off and straightens a bit after landing. Harris decides to leave it alone. Goes on a bounce to Pant.
Short and wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Wide outside off, Harris pushes it to deep point for a single. Keeps the strike.
Bouncer down leg, Harris has no trouble in letting it go.
FOUR! Cut away gorgeously by Harris. Short and wide outside off, Marcus rocks back and places it beautifully to the right of point for four runs.
Fuller on off, Usman leans into the drive and places it down the ground for a run. Gets off the mark.
On a length and defended off the front foot by Usman Khawaja.
Starts off with a length ball on middle and leg, Harris pushes it to the leg side for a run.
Umesh Yadav is on for the first time.
Extra bounce here on this one, Khawaja jumps and defends it with soft hands.
Defended after covering the swing on this ball.
Beaten outside off! A nothing shot to a length delivery. Swings a bit and just misses the outside edge.
Fuller outside off now, the batsman defends it to cover.
Around the wicket, bouncer to welcome the new batsman. Khawaja ducks under it and then gives a smile to Shami.

The players and umpires are back for the third and final session of play. Big news is that Aaron Finch has not come out to bat as he is going to have an X-ray on his index finger. It's Usman Khawaja to take his place. Shami to complete his over...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

A little worry though is the fact that Finch seems to be having a small injury as he walked off on the last ball before Tea. Looks like he will need some medical attention and whether or not he will return to bat post the break is yet to be seen. Join us in a bit as action resumes in the last session, almost 39 overs left in the day.

Australia's session one would believe. They are ahead by 76 runs. The session began when Ishant Sharma joined Rishabh Pant out in the middle. Unfortunately for the visitors, the tail could not wag and only 31 runs were added by them after Lunch before being bowled out. The Aussie openers came out looking determined but had to face a hostile spell of fast bowling from Ishant Sharma and Jasprit Bumrah. There were plays and misses, outside edges that did not carry, dropped catches but credit to the batsmen, they hung on to their wickets and Australia head into the break with their noses well in front in the game.

There is another halt in play as once again the Australian physio is on the field. This time, to check on Aaron Finch's right hand. He seems to have hurt his index finger badly and is going off the field. In fact, all the players are heading back to the pavilion as it is time for Tea on Day 3.

Ouch! Finch has been hit on his finger here. This one is on off and middle, looks to flick it away but the ball rares up and hits Finch on the bottom hand. He drops his bat and immediately calls for the physio. Looks like some real damage here. The commentators on-air remind us that Aaron took a couple of blows on his fingers during the training session as well. He is really looking in pain.
On middle and leg, Harris plays it away to mid-wicket. Maiden over.
Good length ball outside off, Bumrah finds the thick outer half of the bat and the ball rolls to point.
Oooh! It gets the under-edge this time. The ball goes on a few bounces to Rahul at third slip. He dives low to his right and prevents any run but is seen feeling his back afterwards
The southpaw judges the bounce on the ball and lets this go through.
Short of a length again and on middle and off, Harris stands tall and defends.
Good short delivery just in front of the face, Harris sways out of the way and lets it go.
On a good length, the left-hander gets it off the outer half of the bat onto the off side at covers and runs through to the other end. Keeps strike.
Shorter ball on off, Harris punches it off the back foot.
Shortens the length and Marcus goes for a pull. It is not timed too well and goes straight to square leg.
Flicked straight to mid-wicket.
A skidding one on middle and leg, Finch misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pad. Shami appeals but the ball was going down leg. The batsmen pick up a single.
A short ball on the hips to begin with, worked in the gap on the leg side for a single.
Mohammed Shami replaces Ishant Sharma.

FOUR! Finch is looking really good here! That's a half-volley outside off, Finch drives confidently and through the covers and all the way for four. Interestingly, it is also the first ball that Finch played off Bumrah in the entire 10 overs.
Yorker on middle and beautifully kept out by Harris. He digs it out on the off side and gets a single.
Good length ball that comes in slightly after landing on middle, Harris pushes it back to the bowler.
Another fuller length ball outside off, Marcus drives to mid off.
This is pushed away to cover off the front foot.
Beaten outside off! Over the wicket from Bumrah, the ball angles away and beats the outside edge of the bat as Harris hangs back in defense.
Defended solidly off the front foot by the batsman.
Outside off and swinging away at the last moment, Finch looks to poke at it but misses it at the last moment.

FOUR! Pulled away and all the way for another boundary. Shorter length delivery that is aimed at the helmet, Finch swivels and pulls it away behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Two in two, this must make the opener feel a lot better.
FOUR! What a brilliant shot from Finch! The ball is well outside off, the batsman comes ahead and drives confidently to the right of point. It goes all the way for four. Really good-looking shot.
Short of a length and outside off, Finch shoulders his arms to let that one go.
Inswinger on a good length from Ishant, the ball is kept out by Finch.
It's a full delivery, in the region outside off, Harris covers the line and shoulders arms.

Slight halt in play as the physio is out to check on Harris. This is a norm these days and even the helmet has to be rechecked if it needs to be changed. Marcus is looking fine and is sipping some water. We are ready to go again. Will Bumrah go for another bouncer? Or will he fire in a yorker?

OUCH! Nasty from Bumrah. This a short ball and doesn't bounce as much as Harris expects. He tries to duck under it but the ball doesn't bounce enough to go over him. He then tries to sway away but is too late. Gets hit on the front of the grill and goes down but is back on his feet immediately. The leg umpire though halts the play and calls for medical attention. The Indian players also run to him to check his well-being. Good gesture.
Full and outside off, defended back towards the off side.
Another short ball, this time on middle. Harris jumps and keeps it out on the leg side.
Gets behind the line of this short of a length delivery on off and defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off and Harris leaves it alone this time.
Good solid defense to this full one outside off.

FOUR! Just out of the reach of guess who? Yes, Rishabh Pant. A surprise short ball on middle and leg, Finch wants to play a release shot and goes for the pull. The ball climbs up on him and he only gets a glove. Luckily for him, the ball is just away from Pant who dives full stretch to his left for this one. Streaky from Finch. The lead is into the 60s now.
Oooh! Finch pulls out of his defensive shot at the last second. The ball bounces a bit more too. Good disciplined bowling from Ishant here.
Much better! Full face of the bat and defended right back to the bowler.
Back to the probing line, Finch adjusts well to the late movement and defends it to cover-point.
Well outside off and Finch doesn't want anything to do with it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a length and angling in around off, Harris sticks back and allows the ball to come at him. It takes the toe end of his willow and runs through the gap between slips and gully for a couple of runs.
Good length delivery outside off, Harris lets it go safely.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
This one is full and angling in around off, Harris is on the front foot as he drives it out to point.
Lands it on a good length outside off, Harris watches the line closely before making a leave.

Inside edge again. The inward movement is causing all sorts of problem to Aaron Finch. Stays back to defend but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket. Maybe, India should employ a short leg for him.
Vicious movement off the seam! Add some extra bounce to it as well. Ishant is cooking a very good spell here. It's around off, Finch is drawn forward in defense but is hit high on the pads.
Full and angling into the batsman, shaping in off the seam as well, Finch tries playing it with a straight bat but it takes the inside edge and rolls behind square leg for a couple of runs.

DROPPED! In and out of Pujara's hand at first slip. The edge was always coming. Ishant bowls this on off and gets it to straighten again, Harris is stuck on the crease and gets an outside edge as he tries to defend. Pujara has a slight moment of hesitation before diving low to his right. The ball hits his palm but he cannot hold onto it. It was a keeper's catch but Pant is wrong-footed by a couple of steps in his initial movement. You can kind of remember the previous Test when exactly the same thing happened when Lyon was dropped by Pant. He gets wrong-footed quite often and needs to work on his technique. The batsmen run through for a single. Unfortunate for Sharma, has been really bowling well to induce the edge.

Good bowling this! The ball lands on middle and then straightens after landing. Had Harris squared up, he was looking to work it away on the leg side but the ball takes a thick outside edge and rolls to point all along the ground.
Length delivery on middle, Finch pushes ahead but gets an inside edge that goes to fine leg for a single.
Lethal bowling, this. After bowling on a shorter length continuously, Bumrah spears in a yorker on off at 145.8 kph. Harris does well to dig it out.
Targets the off stump with a length ball on off, Harris stays back-footed in defense.

This is class bowling! Another play and a miss! Bumrah hurls it in the channel outside off, a touch short and coming in with the angle. Harris gets forward to play at it but gets beaten as the ball straightens.
Back of a length delivery on off, hitting the surface hard, Marcus is on his back foot as he defends it to the off side.
Harris has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

What a delivery! Shooting off the surface after hitting it on a shortish length around off. Harris pushes inside the line and misses. Excellent take by Pant. Kohli gets excited but nothing from the umpire. Day light in the replays.

What has happened here? The Indians seem confident that they have got their man. But the umpire is unmoved. The ball lands outside off and straightens at the last moment. Finch closes the face of the bat trying to hit it on the leg side but the ball misses the outside edge and probably gets the pad on the way through. Pant collects it nice and low behind the wickets and all the fielders go up in unison. The umpire says not out. The Indian fielders talk amongst themselves and decide not to review in the end. Replays suggest it was a good decision in hindsight as the ball got nothing off the bat and brushed the back leg.

EDGED AND FOUR! Good ball from Sharma, just outside off. Takes the edge of Finch's bat who was looking to defend. The ball flies to the right of third slip and all the way for four. Kohli dives full length but is unable to reach it. Streaky from Finchy. Lead is now 50.
Well outside off, Finch pushes it to the right of backward point and comes back for two.

A peach! After two balls coming in, this one moves away and beats the outside edge of Finch's bat who was looking to defend for the one coming in. There is a slight noise as the bat hits the pad on the way but the Indians don't appeal too much.
Fuller length now, Finch defends much more confidently on this occasion. The ball rolls to mid on.
Length ball outside off, Finch is well ahead and defends it back down the ground.
Beaten! A great delivery to end the over. On a length and Harris who was trying to defend gets beaten on the outside. Maiden over.
Shortens the length but outside off, left alone again.
This ball is outside off again, slightly fuller and it is left alone. Pant has a tough time gathering it as the ball swerves after passing the wickets.
Short of a length outside off, Marcus stands tall and defends.
Further outside off on this occasion, Harris lets it go through.
Around the wicket, starts off with a ball on off and good length. Harris is watchful in defense with a straight bat.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the new ball from the other end.
Outside off and fuller length, Finch is well ahead and pushes it to mid on.
Lands outside off and jags back in a long way. Finch looks to leave it and the ball comes in to hit him on the thigh.
Beaten outside off! This one moves the other way and the right-hander looking to defend the ball to the off side misses the ball. It goes through to Pant.
Good ball swinging in after landing, Finch deals with it well and pushes it to mid on.
Well outside off on a length, Finch shoulders arms to it.
Good ball on a length to start off with, Harris defends well towards the off side. The batsmen take a single and Australia are off the mark straightaway.
